name: bob-poker-timer
description: Poker tournament clock + management app. Laptop drives a TV over HDMI and hosts a phone remote over a hotspot LAN.

scripts.start: npm run build && cross-env NODE_ENV=production tsx server/src/index.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared/tsconfig.json && tsc -p server/tsconfig.json && tsc -p client/tsconfig.json
